description: This file contains utility functions for clipboard operations and UI notifications in a ReactJS project. Specifically, it defines functions to securely copy text to the clipboard with fallbacks, and to show inline toast messages for user notifications.

methods.name: safeCopyToClipboard(text)
methods.description: Asynchronously attempts to copy provided text to the clipboard using modern APIs with fallback to deprecated execCommand method. Returns true if copy succeeds, false otherwise.

methods.name: showInlineToast(message, durationMs = 2000)
methods.description: Displays a temporary, non-intrusive message at the bottom of the viewport. Automatically fades out after a specified duration.
